document_data.title: Sports Clearance Document for Taylor Nguyen
document_data.content: This is to certify that Taylor Nguyen, a 15-year-old female with a history of asthma, has undergone a recent check-up on 2023-10-01. The patient has been evaluated and is deemed fit to participate in sports activities, provided she continues to manage her asthma condition with the prescribed medication (alprazolam) and follows the necessary precautions to ensure her health and safety during physical activities. Note: The patient's mental health treatment history has been excluded from this document as requested by the patient/guardian.
